newsitem.title: CHINA: Chinese coal mine explosion kills nine.
newsitem.headline: Chinese coal mine explosion kills nine.

text.p: Nine miners were killed in an explosion at an illegal coal mine in southern China this week, an official newspaper said.
A spark from a crude electrical switch ignited gas, killing all the workers in the pit at Yangchun in Guangdong province, the Nanfang Ribao said in an edition seen in Beijing on Saturday.
The newspaper said local people had ignored repeated warnings to shut the pit before the blast occurred on Tuesday.
Accidents in China's coal mines claim the lives of some 10,000 people every year. Most of the deaths occur at small, unregulated pits.
